empty.comingSoonDesc.zh: 我哋暫未開放此品類嘅交易，敬請期待。
empty.comingSoonDesc.en: Trading for this category has not yet opened. Please stay tuned for future availability.

endOfResults.zh: — 已顯示全部 {total} 件商品 —

filter.conditionHint.zh: 顯示所選或更好嘅成色

delivery.shipDesc.zh: 有鑑定：賣家寄→鑑定師→你；無鑑定：賣家直寄你
delivery.shipDesc.en: With authentication: seller ships to authenticator then you; without: seller ships directly to you

delivery.meetupAuthDesc.zh: 你去鑑定師地點，當場鑑定 + 交收
delivery.meetupAuthDesc.en: You go to the authenticator's location for on-site authentication and handover

delivery.meetup3wayDesc.zh: 你、賣家、鑑定師同場，當場鑑定 + 交收
delivery.meetup3wayDesc.en: You, seller, and authenticator meet on-site for authentication and handover

delivery.meetupDirectDesc.zh: 純撮合、無鑑定，你同賣家直接見面
delivery.meetupDirectDesc.en: Pure matchmaking, no authentication — you meet the seller directly

payment.escrowDesc.zh: 平台代收款項，交易完成後派款畀賣家 + 鑑定師
payment.escrowDesc.en: The platform holds the payment and releases it to the seller and authenticator upon transaction completion.

payment.cashDirectDesc.zh: 買家自行付款畀賣家 (FPS / 銀行轉帳 / 現金)，平台不託管
payment.cashDirectDesc.en: The buyer pays the seller directly (FPS / bank transfer / cash). The platform does not hold the payment.

reserved.bannerTitle.en: This item is in an active transaction

reserved.bannerDesc.zh: 已有買家落單，暫時唔可以購買。
reserved.bannerDesc.en: A buyer has placed an order for this item. It is currently unavailable for purchase.

sold.bannerDesc.zh: 交易已完成，呢件商品唔可以再買入。可以睇下面類似商品 ↓
sold.bannerDesc.en: Transaction completed. This item is no longer available. Check similar items below ↓

chat.askSimilarSold.zh: 問賣家有冇同類貨或補貨計劃
chat.askSimilarSold.en: Inquire whether the seller has similar items or anticipates restocking.

chat.askSimilarReserved.en: Inquire whether the seller has similar items.

price.negotiatedConfirm.zh: 議價已確認，請完成落單
price.negotiatedConfirm.en: The negotiated price has been confirmed. Please proceed to complete your order.

price.deadlineSoon.zh: 請盡快完成落單，否則預留會自動取消。
price.deadlineSoon.en: Please complete your order soon, otherwise the reservation will be automatically cancelled.

price.tierChanged.zh: ⓘ 協議價格屬 {tier}，與原 listing tier 不同。
price.tierChanged.en: ⓘ The agreed price falls under {tier}, which differs from the original listing tier.

tier.descT3.zh: 此商品成交價 ≥ HKD 10,000，落單時必須由具名鑑定師鑑定通過方可完成交易。真偽責任由該鑑定師按合約及 E&O 保險承擔。
tier.descT3.en: This item's transaction price is ≥ HKD 10,000. A named authenticator must verify it before the transaction can complete. Authenticity liability is assumed by the authenticator per their contract and E&O insurance.

tier.descT2.zh: 此商品可選鑑定。買家可於落單時揀鑑定師增加信心，鑑定費由買家承擔。
tier.descT2.en: Authentication is optional for this item. Buyers can choose an authenticator at checkout for added confidence, with the fee borne by the buyer.

tier.descT1.zh: 此商品屬純撮合，成交前建議自行核實真偽及成色。平台不承擔真偽責任。
tier.descT1.en: This is a matchmaking-only listing. We recommend verifying authenticity and condition yourself before transacting. The platform does not assume authenticity liability.

tier.disclaimer.zh: 平台為資訊中介，真偽由具名鑑定師負責，Certifine 不作真偽保證。
tier.disclaimer.en: The platform is an information intermediary. Authenticity is the responsibility of the named authenticator. Certifine does not guarantee authenticity.

conversations.hint.zh: 任何狀態都可以同對方傾偈；對話完成 / 退款 / 爭議後變 read-only 存檔。
conversations.hint.en: You can message the other party at any stage. After completion, refund, or dispute, conversations become read-only archives.

seller.ownerHint.zh: 買家會在呢度見到揀鑑定師、交收同付款嘅選項。你唔可以購買自己嘅商品。
seller.ownerHint.en: Buyers will see authenticator, delivery, and payment options here. You cannot purchase your own items.

buyer.trackOrderTitle.en: You are the buyer for this order

buyer.cancelReleaseNote.zh: 如果交易最終取消或退款，商品會重新上架。
buyer.cancelReleaseNote.en: If the transaction is cancelled or refunded, the item will be re-listed.

buyer.notYetOrdered.zh: 如果你已經係呢張訂單嘅買家，可以在「我的訂單」追蹤進度。
buyer.notYetOrdered.en: If you are the buyer for this order, you can track progress in "My Orders".

t3Banner.desc.zh: 此商品價格 ≥ HKD 10,000，必須揀一位平台註冊鑑定師驗證後才會放款。
t3Banner.desc.en: This item is priced ≥ HKD 10,000. You must select a registered authenticator to verify it before payment is released.

step2.noAuthDesc.zh: 自行承擔風險、無鑑定費
step2.noAuthDesc.en: At your own risk. No authentication fee applies.

step2.noAuthCategory.zh: 此品類暫無註冊鑑定師。
step2.noAuthCategory.en: No registered authenticators for this category yet.

step2.noAuthWarning.zh: ⚠️ 此品類暫時冇平台註冊鑑定師。需要鑑定師嘅交收方式暫時不可選。
step2.noAuthWarning.en: ⚠️ There are currently no registered authenticators for this category. Delivery methods requiring an authenticator are unavailable.

branch.selectLabel.zh: 交收分店（由鑑定師提供）

branch.pickAuthFirst.zh: 請先揀鑑定師，先會顯示佢嘅分店列表。
branch.pickAuthFirst.en: Please select an authenticator first to see their branch list.

branch.noBranches.zh: 呢位鑑定師暫時冇可用分店，請揀其他鑑定師或交收方式。
branch.noBranches.en: This authenticator has no available branches. Please choose another authenticator or delivery method.

branch.disclaimer.zh: 交收地點由鑑定師提供，平台中立 — 請依時到場。
branch.disclaimer.en: Meetup locations are provided by the authenticator. The platform is neutral — please arrive on time.

meetupDirect.customPlaceholder.zh: 請填寫你建議嘅面交地點

meetupDirect.hint.zh: 賣家建議地點供參考，如需更改可揀「其他」並填寫。
meetupDirect.hint.en: The seller's suggested location is for reference. Select "Other" to suggest a different one.

payment.shipNoAuthWarning.zh: 物流寄送（無鑑定師）：平台唔會託管款項，買賣雙方需要自行協議付款方式 (FPS / 銀行轉帳 / 現金)。如出現爭議，平台冇方法協助處理，請自行解決。
payment.shipNoAuthWarning.en: Shipping without authentication: The platform does not hold the payment. The buyer and seller must arrange payment directly (FPS / bank transfer / cash). If a dispute arises, the platform is unable to assist. Please resolve the matter between yourselves.

payment.offlineCashWarning.zh: 線下現金交收平台不會託管款項，未能提供款項保障，請自行注意交收安全。
payment.offlineCashWarning.en: Offline cash transactions are not held by the platform and offer no payment protection. Please ensure safety during the meetup.

loginPrompt.en: Not logged in? Please log in first.

chat.readonlyCompleted.zh: 訂單已完成，對話存檔僅供查閱。
chat.readonlyCompleted.en: Order completed. Conversation archived for reference.

chat.readonlyRefunded.zh: 訂單已退款，對話存檔僅供查閱。
chat.readonlyRefunded.en: Order refunded. Conversation archived for reference.

chat.readonlyDisputed.zh: 訂單爭議處理中，對話已鎖定。
chat.readonlyDisputed.en: Order is under dispute. Conversation has been locked.

error.chooseAuth.zh: 此交收方式需要鑑定，請先揀一位鑑定師
error.chooseAuth.en: This delivery method requires authentication. Please select an authenticator first.

error.chooseBranch.zh: 請揀鑑定師嘅交收分店

error.enterMeetupLocation.zh: 請填寫你建議嘅面交地點
error.enterMeetupLocation.en: Please enter your suggested meetup location

basic.brandAIIntelligence.zh: 揀預設{fieldLabel}之後將來可以幫你 AI 自動識別商品；自訂亦會儲存但 AI 識別會較弱。
basic.brandAIIntelligence.en: Choosing a preset {fieldLabel} will enable AI-based auto-recognition for your items in the future. Custom entries will be saved, but AI recognition may be less accurate.

basic.brandNoResult.zh: 揾唔到「{search}」相關{fieldLabel}。揀「其他」自訂。
basic.brandNoResult.en: No {fieldLabel} found for "{search}". Select "Other" to add a custom one.

basic.conditionDisclaimer.zh: 成色由你申報，Certifine 不驗證。Tier 2/3 商品鑑定時以鑑定師意見為準。
basic.conditionDisclaimer.en: Condition is self-declared. Certifine does not verify it. For Tier 2/3 items, the authenticator's assessment takes precedence during authentication.

basic.descPlaceholder.zh: 購入日期、配件齊全度、瑕疵說明、購入地點 / 單據…
basic.descPlaceholder.en: Purchase date, completeness of accessories, defect notes, place of purchase / receipt…

basic.titlePlaceholder.zh: 例：Chanel Classic Flap Medium Caviar Black
basic.titlePlaceholder.en: e.g. Chanel Classic Flap Medium Caviar Black

delete.consequence.zh: 商品會即時落架，買家搵唔到。刪錯咗可以隨時在「我的上架」還原。
delete.consequence.en: The item will be taken down immediately and will not be visible to buyers. You can restore it at any time from "My Listings."

delivery.district.zh: 你所在區域（面交配對用，選填，可揀多個候選）
delivery.district.en: Your district (for meetup matching, optional, multiple allowed)

delivery.hint.zh: 揀你願意接受嘅交收方式（可多選），買家落單時會在你接受嘅方式入面揀一種。
delivery.hint.en: Select the delivery methods you are willing to accept (multiple allowed). Buyers will choose from your accepted options at checkout.

delivery.meetup3wayDesc.zh: 你、買家、鑑定師同場，當場鑑定 + 交收
delivery.meetup3wayDesc.en: You, buyer, and authenticator meet on-site for authentication and handover

delivery.meetupAuthDesc.zh: 買家去鑑定師地點，當場鑑定 + 交收
delivery.meetupAuthDesc.en: Buyer goes to the authenticator's location for on-site authentication and handover

delivery.meetupDirectDesc.zh: 純撮合、無鑑定，你同買家直接見面
delivery.meetupDirectDesc.en: Pure matchmaking, no authentication — you meet the buyer directly

delivery.meetupLocationPlaceholder.zh: 例：旺角港鐵站 E 出口
delivery.meetupLocationPlaceholder.en: e.g. Mong Kok MTR Station Exit E

delivery.meetupLocations.zh: 面交地點（買家落單時揀選）

delivery.meetupLocationsHint.zh: 請提供至少一個建議面交地點，買家可揀選或填寫其他地點。
delivery.meetupLocationsHint.en: Please provide at least one suggested meetup location. Buyers can choose or suggest another.

delivery.shipDesc.zh: 有鑑定：你寄→鑑定師→買家；無鑑定：直寄買家
delivery.shipDesc.en: With authentication: you ship to the authenticator, then to the buyer. Without: ship directly to the buyer.

error.imageTooLarge.zh: 每張圖片不可超過 50MB，已略過 {n} 張超大圖片。
error.imageTooLarge.en: Each image must not exceed 50MB. {n} oversized images were skipped.

error.mixedLimits.zh: 部分圖片超過 50MB，另有圖片超出 {MAX_IMAGES} 張上限，未能加入。
error.mixedLimits.en: Some images exceed 50MB, and others exceed the {MAX_IMAGES} limit. None were added.

error.notActive.zh: 商品已被預訂或售出，唔可以修改
error.notActive.en: The item has been reserved or sold and cannot be edited

error.notOwner.zh: 唔可以修改其他賣家嘅商品
error.notOwner.en: You cannot edit another seller's listing

error.photoDecode.zh: 呢張相無法解碼（可能格式不支援）
error.photoDecode.en: This photo cannot be decoded (format may not be supported)

error.tooManyImages.zh: 最多只可上載 {MAX_IMAGES} 張圖片。
error.tooManyImages.en: You can only upload up to {MAX_IMAGES} images.

error.videoTooLarge.zh: 影片不可超過 15MB（你揀嘅檔案 {size}MB）
error.videoTooLarge.en: Video must not exceed 15MB (your file is {size}MB)

error.videoTooLong.zh: 影片不可超過 {MAX_SECONDS} 秒（你揀嘅 {duration} 秒）
error.videoTooLong.en: Video must not exceed {MAX_SECONDS} seconds (yours is {duration} seconds)

media.addVideo.zh: ▶ 加入商品影片（選填，最多 15 秒）
media.addVideo.en: ▶ Add a product video (optional, max 15 sec)

media.maxLimit.zh: 最多 {MAX_IMAGES} 張 · 支援 iPhone / Android 原相（會自動壓縮）· 第一張為主圖
media.maxLimit.en: Up to {MAX_IMAGES} images · Supports iPhone / Android originals (auto-compressed) · The first image becomes the cover

media.sortHint.zh: 💡 拖拉圖片可改變次序；第一張自動成為主圖
media.sortHint.en: 💡 Drag to reorder images. The first becomes the cover photo.

media.videoCover.zh: 將影片作為主圖（browse card cover）
media.videoCover.en: Use video as cover (browse card cover)

media.videoSpecs.zh: ≤ 15 秒 / ≤ 15MB · 自動截首幀做縮圖

photo.counter.zh: 已上載 {total} / {max} 張 · 最少 {min} 張

photo.error.oversize.zh: 已略過 {n} 張超過 50MB 嘅相

priceDrop.confirmDesc.zh: 此商品有 {count} 個未處理嘅議價。減價會排程在 48 小時 後生效；期間買家仍會見原售價，你嘅議價對手亦可能會基於原價繼續傾。建議先處理議價再改價。
priceDrop.confirmDesc.en: This item has {count} pending negotiations. The price drop will be scheduled to take effect in 48 hours. Buyers will still see the original price during this period, and negotiation parties may continue bargaining based on the original price. We recommend handling negotiations before changing the price.

priceDrop.pendingDate.zh: 將於 {date} 自動生效。買家現在仍見到原售價。
priceDrop.pendingDate.en: Will take effect on {date}. Buyers will still see the original price until then.

rail.disclaimer.zh: 最終金額以成交時 server 計算為準。平台為資訊中介，真偽由具名鑑定師負責。
rail.disclaimer.en: Final amounts are determined by the server at transaction time. The platform is an information intermediary; authenticity is handled by the named authenticator.

rail.noPriceHint.zh: 輸入售價後，系統會即時顯示鑑定分級。
rail.noPriceHint.en: Enter a price to see the authentication tier.

rail.tierDesc2.zh: 售價 HK$1,000–9,999，買家可選擇是否鑑定。
rail.tierDesc2.en: Price HK$1,000–9,999. Buyer can choose whether to use authentication.

rail.tierDesc3.zh: 售價 ≥ HK$10,000，必須指定鑑定師，買家款項全程託管。
rail.tierDesc3.en: Price ≥ HK$10,000. A specific authenticator is required. Buyer funds are held in escrow throughout.

station.hint.zh: 揀一條綫連續多選（撳一下加、再撳取消），或者直接打站名搜尋
station.hint.en: Tap along a line to select several stations (tap again to remove), or search by name

station.limitReached.zh: 已達 {max} 個候選上限 — 想換站請先移除一個
station.limitReached.en: You have reached the limit of {max} — remove one to add another

station.noMatch.zh: 搵唔到「{query}」— 請由港鐵站揀選（唔可以自由填寫）
station.noMatch.en: No match for “{query}” — pick an MTR station from the list (free text is not accepted)

station.placeholder.zh: ＋ 選擇所在港鐵站（選填，最多 {max} 個候選）
station.placeholder.en: + Pick your MTR station (optional, up to {max})

station.searchPlaceholder.zh: 打站名（例：旺角）— 只可以喺建議入面揀
station.searchPlaceholder.en: Type a station name — you can only pick from the suggestions

subtitle.create.zh: 填寫貨品資料。系統會按售價自動判斷鑑定分級。
subtitle.create.en: Fill in your item details. The system will determine the authentication tier based on the price.

subtitle.edit.zh: 只可以在商品上架中（未有買家落單）時修改。被預訂或售出後就會 locked。
subtitle.edit.en: You can only edit listings that are active (no buyer has placed an order yet). Listings become locked once reserved or sold.

validation.deliveryRequired.zh: 請至少揀一種接受嘅交收方式
validation.deliveryRequired.en: Please select at least one delivery method

validation.imageOrVideo.zh: ⓘ 請先上載至少一張商品圖片或一段影片，先可以發佈上架。
validation.imageOrVideo.en: ⓘ Please upload at least one photo or a video before publishing.

validation.imageRequired.zh: 請至少上載一張商品圖片或一段影片
validation.imageRequired.en: Please upload at least one photo or a video

applePay.notice.zh: 真實環境：撳一下會跳 Touch ID / Face ID。Mock 模式：揀下面 dev button。
applePay.notice.en: In production this opens Touch ID / Face ID. In mock mode, use the dev buttons below.

card.cvvHint.en: 3 digits on the back of the card

card.cvvHintAmex.en: 4 digits on the front of the card

card.error.expiryFormat.en: Expiry date must look like MM/YY

card.error.nameInvalid.en: That name format is not valid

card.error.numberInvalid.en: That card number is not valid

card.error.numberLength.en: The card number should be {len} digits

card.nameLabel.zh: 持卡人姓名（同卡上一致）
card.nameLabel.en: Cardholder name (as printed on the card)

card.saveCard.zh: 儲存呢張卡用嚟下次付款
card.saveCard.en: Save this card for next time

deadline.notice.zh: 付款時限 — 過時訂單自動取消
deadline.notice.en: Payment window — the order is cancelled automatically once it passes

deadline.warning.zh: ⏰ 付款時限快到（剩 {mins} 分鐘）— 請盡快完成付款，否則訂單會自動取消。
deadline.warning.en: ⏰ The payment window closes in {mins} min — pay soon or the order is cancelled automatically.

error.confirmTimeout.zh: 付款確認超時 — 請稍後喺訂單頁檢查狀態，唔好重複付款
error.confirmTimeout.en: Payment confirmation timed out — check the order page shortly. Do not pay again.

error.deadlinePassed.zh: 付款時限已過 — 請重新落單
error.deadlinePassed.en: The payment window has closed — please order again

error.expired.zh: 付款時限已過，訂單已取消 — 請重新落單
error.expired.en: Payment deadline has passed. Order cancelled — please place a new order.

error.network.en: Network error. Please try again later.

error.timeout.zh: 付款確認超時 — 請稍後在訂單頁檢查狀態，唔好重複付款
error.timeout.en: Payment confirmation timed out — please check the order page shortly. Do not make a duplicate payment.

escrow.chargedNotice.zh: 平台已正式扣款 {amount}（Tier 1 即時 charge）。
escrow.chargedNotice.en: You have been charged {amount} (Tier 1 charges immediately).

escrow.explainerTier1.zh: Tier 1 訂單即時扣款，交收完成前平台託管，有問題可以開爭議。
escrow.explainerTier1.en: Tier 1 orders are charged immediately. The platform holds the funds until handover is complete, and you can raise a dispute if anything goes wrong.

escrow.explainerTiered.zh: 託管保障：確認付款後，平台會 hold 住呢筆錢（唔會即刻過數俾賣家）。鑑定師核實正貨後先正式扣款放行；鑑定唔過會全額退返俾你。
escrow.explainerTiered.en: Escrow protection: after you confirm, the platform holds the funds instead of passing them to the seller. They are released only once the authenticator verifies the item; if it fails authentication you are refunded in full.

escrow.holdNotice.zh: 平台已 hold 你嘅 {amount} 直至鑑定完成。鑑定師核實後先正式扣款。
escrow.holdNotice.en: The platform is holding your {amount} until authentication finishes. It is charged only after the authenticator verifies the item.

expired.body.zh: 訂單超過 30 分鐘未完成付款，已自動取消，貨品已重新上架俾其他買家。如仍想購買，請返回商品頁重新落單。
expired.body.en: The order was not paid within 30 minutes, so it was cancelled automatically and the item is listed again for other buyers. To buy it, go back to the item page and order again.

expired.desc.zh: 訂單超過 30 分鐘未完成付款，已自動取消，貨品已重新上架俾其他買家。如仍想購買，請返回商品頁重新落單。
expired.desc.en: The order was not paid within 30 minutes and has been automatically cancelled. The item has been re-listed for other buyers. If you still wish to purchase, please return to the listing page and place a new order.

method.alipay.tagline.en: Scan a QR code · instant payment

method.fps.tagline.zh: 銀行 app 即時轉賬
method.fps.tagline.en: Instant transfer from your banking app

method.wechat.tagline.en: Hong Kong wallet · scan a QR code

offlineCash.directDesc.zh: 直接面交訂單必須現金支付，冇網上付款步驟。同賣家約好時間地點，見面一手交錢一手交貨。
offlineCash.directDesc.en: Direct meetup orders must be paid in cash. There are no online payment steps. Arrange a time and place with the seller and exchange on the spot.

offlineCash.genericDesc.zh: 呢張單揀咗線下現金，冇網上付款步驟。
offlineCash.genericDesc.en: This order uses offline cash payment with no online payment steps.

offlineCash.title.zh: 此訂單為線下現金交收
offlineCash.title.en: This is an offline cash transaction

pay.submitAgree.zh: 撳「{authLabel}」即表示你同意 Certifine 服務條款 + 鑑定流程
pay.submitAgree.en: By clicking "{authLabel}", you agree to Certifine's Terms of Service and authentication process.

review.confirmButton.en: Confirm order and proceed to payment

review.deliveryMeetup3way.zh: 🤝 三方同場面交 — 你、賣家、鑑定師約同一時間地點，即場鑑定即場交收
review.deliveryMeetup3way.en: 🤝 Three-way meetup — you, seller, and authenticator meet at the same time and place for on-site authentication and handover

review.deliveryMeetupAuth.zh: 🏬 鑑定師分店交收 — 賣家交貨去分店，鑑定通過後你去分店取貨

confirmDialog.cancelConsequence.en: The buyer will receive a full refund immediately and the item will be re-listed. The authenticator's photos will be retained for audit. This action cannot be undone.

confirmDialog.reasonPlaceholder.en: e.g. Seller is no longer selling / Unable to arrange a meeting time.

whatWeAre.body1.zh: Certifine 係一個在香港運作嘅 C2C（個人對個人）二手精品交易平台。我哋撮合買家、賣家、同獨立鑑定師三方，並按品類強制／可選第三方鑑定 — 凡單價 ≥ HKD 10,000 嘅貨品必須經獨立鑑定師驗證後先可以完成交易。
whatWeAre.body1.en: Certifine is a C2C (consumer-to-consumer) secondhand luxury marketplace operating in Hong Kong. We connect buyers, sellers, and independent authenticators — with mandatory or optional third-party authentication by category. Any item priced at HKD 10,000 or above must be verified by an independent authenticator before the transaction can be completed.

whatWeAre.body2.zh: 我哋唔擁有亦唔銷售任何商品。我哋係一個資訊撮合服務（information intermediary）：提供 listing 上架、搜尋、訊息、escrow 託管同鑑定預約嘅技術設施，但交易雙方為買家同賣家，鑑定責任歸屬具名鑑定師。
whatWeAre.body2.en: We do not own or sell any goods. We are an information intermediary: we provide the technical infrastructure for listings, search, messaging, escrow, and authentication booking, but the transaction is between buyer and seller, and authentication responsibility rests with the named authenticator.

tierSystem.subtitle.zh: 每件 listing 按成交金額自動分入以下三層，鑑定要求同收費皆不同：
tierSystem.subtitle.en: Each listing is automatically classified into one of three tiers based on the transaction amount. Authentication requirements and fees vary by tier:

tierSystem.tier1.description.zh: 純撮合，無強制鑑定。買家自行判斷。
tierSystem.tier1.description.en: Matching only — no mandatory authentication. Buyer relies on their own judgment.

tierSystem.tier2.description.zh: 可選鑑定。雙方可協議由邊一方支付鑑定費。
tierSystem.tier2.description.en: Optional authentication. Both parties can agree on who bears the authentication fee.

tierSystem.tier3.description.zh: 強制鑑定。系統會拒絕無鑑定師參與嘅落單。
tierSystem.tier3.description.en: Mandatory authentication. The system will reject any order without an authenticator assigned.

authenticators.body1.zh: 每位鑑定師皆為以個人或實體名義在平台註冊嘅獨立第三方專業人士。佢哋具備：

authenticators.list.1.en: Verified real name, business address, and years of industry experience publicly disclosed

authenticators.list.3.zh: 專業責任保險（Errors & Omissions Insurance）

authenticators.list.4.zh: 自主決定鑑定費率（以貨價百分比 + 最低收費表達）

authenticators.body2.zh: 鑑定結論為鑑定師之專業意見，責任歸屬該位具名鑑定師。平台從未亦不會以「我哋保證」或「by Certifine」嘅形式發出真偽聲明。
authenticators.body2.en: Authentication conclusions are the professional opinions of the named authenticator, who bears the corresponding responsibility. The platform has never and will never issue authenticity statements in the form of "we guarantee" or "by Certifine".

fees.authFee.en: Authentication fee: set by the authenticator (percentage + minimum fee) and clearly displayed at checkout.

fees.escrow.en: Escrow: the buyer's payment is held by the platform and released to the seller only after authentication has been passed and the buyer has confirmed receipt.

fees.disclaimer.zh: 所有金額以港幣 HKD 計算，採用 server 端結算，前端顯示為唯讀。
fees.disclaimer.en: All amounts are denominated in HKD, calculated server-side, and displayed as read-only on the frontend.

legal.body1.en: We adopt the legal position of an information intermediary. This position is informed by the principle established in European Court of Justice case C-324/09 (L'Oréal SA v eBay International AG, 12 July 2011): as long as the platform does not play an active role in controlling seller content, it does not bear direct legal liability for the authenticity of goods. All authenticity conclusions are the responsibility of the named authenticator.

intro.zh: 本政策說明 Certifine Ltd.（「本平台」、「我哋」）如何收集、使用、儲存、披露及保護你嘅個人資料。我哋遵從香港《個人資料（私隱）條例》（Cap. 486，下稱「條例」）所訂明嘅六項保障資料原則（Data Protection Principles, DPP1 – DPP6）。
intro.en: This policy explains how Certifine Ltd. ("the Platform," "we," "us") collects, uses, stores, discloses, and protects your personal data. We comply with the six Data Protection Principles (DPP1 – DPP6) set out in the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486, the "Ordinance") of Hong Kong.

dpp1.heading.zh: 1. 收集嘅資料種類 · DPP1（收集目的及方式）
dpp1.heading.en: 1. Types of Data Collected · DPP1 (Purpose and Manner of Collection)

dpp1.body.zh: 我哋只會以合法及公平嘅方式收集為履行平台服務直接相關所必需嘅個人資料：
dpp1.body.en: We only collect personal data that is directly necessary for the provision of our platform services, using lawful and fair means:

dpp1.list.account.zh: 帳戶資料：電郵、密碼雜湊、顯示名稱、頭像。
dpp1.list.account.en: Account data: email, password hash, display name, avatar.

dpp1.list.contact.zh: 聯絡資料：手提電話（如選填）、Google SSO 之 email 證實狀態。
dpp1.list.contact.en: Contact details: mobile phone (if provided), Google SSO email verification status.

dpp1.list.kyc.zh: 身分驗證 (KYC)：身分證副本、自拍照（適用於高層級交易）。
dpp1.list.kyc.en: Identity verification (KYC): copy of ID document, selfie (for high-value transactions).

dpp1.list.transaction.zh: 交易資料：商品 listing 內容、訊息、訂單、發貨地址、付款憑證、爭議紀錄。
dpp1.list.transaction.en: Transaction data: listing content, messages, orders, shipping addresses, payment records, and dispute records.

dpp1.list.technical.zh: 技術資料：IP 位址、瀏覽器類型、裝置識別碼、登入時間、操作日誌。
dpp1.list.technical.en: Technical data: IP address, browser type, device identifier, login times, activity logs.

dpp1.purposes.zh: 收集目的包括：（一）核實用戶身分；（二）撮合及完成交易；（三）爭議處理；（四）防止詐騙、洗錢及違法行為；（五）法律合規；（六）改進服務。如未能提供某些必要資料，可能無法使用相關功能。
dpp1.purposes.en: Purposes of collection include: (i) verifying user identity; (ii) facilitating and completing transactions; (iii) dispute resolution; (iv) preventing fraud, money laundering, and illegal activity; (v) legal compliance; (vi) service improvement. Failure to provide certain required data may prevent you from using related features.

dpp2.body1.zh: 我哋會採取合理步驟確保所持有之個人資料準確。用戶可隨時透過
dpp2.body1.en: We take reasonable steps to ensure the personal data we hold is accurate. Users can update their personal data at any time via

dpp2.retention.account.zh: 帳戶資料：直至帳戶被刪除後 90 日；如有未完成交易或爭議，保留至完結後 7 年。
dpp2.retention.account.en: Account data: until 90 days after account deletion; if there are incomplete transactions or disputes, retained until 7 years after resolution.

dpp2.retention.kyc.zh: KYC 資料：依《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（Cap. 615）要求保留至少 5 年。
dpp2.retention.kyc.en: KYC data: retained for at least 5 years as required by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615).

dpp2.retention.transaction.zh: 交易紀錄：保留 7 年以符合稅務及商業紀錄要求。
dpp2.retention.transaction.en: Transaction records: retained for 7 years to meet tax and business record requirements.

dpp2.retention.logs.zh: 技術日誌：通常保留 90 日；爭議或安全事件相關日誌可延長至調查完結。
dpp2.retention.logs.en: Technical logs: typically retained for 90 days; logs related to disputes or security incidents may be retained until the investigation concludes.

dpp3.body.zh: 我哋只會將個人資料用於收集時告知之目的，或事先取得用戶明確同意之新目的。在無同意下，我哋只會於以下情況披露：
dpp3.body.en: We will only use personal data for the purposes notified at the time of collection, or for new purposes for which we have obtained prior explicit consent from the user. Without consent, we will only disclose personal data in the following circumstances:

dpp3.list.1.zh: 對交易另一方披露完成交易所必需之最少資料（例如：賣家見到買家發貨地址、買家見到賣家顯示名稱）；
dpp3.list.1.en: Disclosing to the other party to a transaction the minimum data necessary to complete it (e.g., the seller sees the buyer's shipping address, the buyer sees the seller's display name);

dpp3.list.2.zh: 對鑑定師披露與該宗鑑定直接相關之商品及交易資料；
dpp3.list.2.en: Disclosing to the authenticator the item and transaction data directly relevant to the authentication;

dpp3.list.3.zh: 對支付處理商、雲端儲存供應商等服務供應商披露完成服務所必需之資料，並要求其遵守同等保密義務；
dpp3.list.3.en: Disclosing to service providers such as payment processors and cloud storage providers the data necessary to perform their services, with a requirement that they observe equivalent confidentiality obligations;

dpp3.list.4.zh: 依法律、法院命令或執法機構合法要求披露。
dpp3.list.4.en: Disclosure as required by law, court order, or lawful request from law enforcement authorities.

dpp3.noSale.zh: 我哋唔會將你嘅個人資料出售予第三方作直接促銷用途。如未來擬作該等用途，將事先尋求用戶之書面同意（依條例第 35C 條）。
dpp3.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal data to third parties for direct marketing purposes. Should we intend to do so in the future, we will first seek the user's written consent (in accordance with section 35C of the Ordinance).

dpp4.body.zh: 我哋採取下列實際可行措施保護個人資料免受未經授權或意外存取、處理、刪除、遺失或使用：
dpp4.body.en: We implement the following practical measures to protect personal data from unauthorised or accidental access, processing, deletion, loss, or use:

dpp4.list.1.zh: 傳輸層加密（HTTPS／TLS）涵蓋所有用戶端與伺服器之間之通訊；
dpp4.list.1.en: Transport layer encryption (HTTPS/TLS) covering all communication between clients and servers;

dpp4.list.2.zh: 密碼以單向雜湊（bcrypt）儲存，從不以明文保留；
dpp4.list.2.en: Passwords stored using one-way hashing (bcrypt), never retained in plaintext;

dpp4.list.3.zh: 權限分層及最少必要原則：員工只會在工作需要時存取相應資料；
dpp4.list.3.en: Role-based access control and the principle of least privilege: staff only access data as necessary for their work;

dpp4.list.5.zh: 第三方雲端服務供應商須通過 ISO 27001 或 SOC 2 同等認證。
dpp4.list.5.en: Third-party cloud service providers must hold ISO 27001 or equivalent SOC 2 certification.

dpp5.body.zh: 本政策、服務條款及就特定功能（如鑑定預約、爭議申訴）之收集陳述均公開於本平台。如有重大變更，我哋會於本頁更新並（如適用）以電郵通知用戶。
dpp5.body.en: This policy, the Terms of Service, and collection statements for specific features (such as authentication booking and dispute filing) are publicly available on the platform. In the event of material changes, we will update this page and, where applicable, notify users by email.

dpp6.body.zh: 按條例第 18 及 22 條，你有權：
dpp6.body.en: Under sections 18 and 22 of the Ordinance, you have the right to:

dpp6.list.1.zh: 查詢我哋有否持有你之個人資料；
dpp6.list.1.en: Enquire whether we hold your personal data;

dpp6.list.2.zh: 取得該等資料之副本（我哋可能依條例第 28(2) 條收取合理費用）；
dpp6.list.2.en: Obtain a copy of such data (we may charge a reasonable fee in accordance with section 28(2) of the Ordinance);

dpp6.list.3.zh: 要求更正不準確之資料；

dpp6.list.4.zh: 撤回先前同意之資料處理（不影響撤回前合法處理）。
dpp6.list.4.en: Withdraw previously given consent to data processing (without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal).

dpp6.contact.zh: 請將查閱或更正要求以書面發送至
dpp6.contact.en: Please send access or correction requests in writing to

dpp6.responseTime.zh: 我哋將於 40 日內回覆。

You may disable cookies through your browser settings, but some features (such as staying logged in) may not function properly. We currently do not use third-party advertising tracking.

crossBorder.body.zh: 我哋之主要數據儲存設施位於香港。如出於技術需要將資料傳輸至香港境外（例如使用全球性雲端服務），我哋會確保接收方之保護水平不低於條例要求。
crossBorder.body.en: Our primary data storage facilities are located in Hong Kong. If data needs to be transferred outside Hong Kong for technical reasons (e.g., use of global cloud services), we will ensure that the recipient's level of protection is no less than that required by the Ordinance.

children.body.zh: 本平台只供 18 歲或以上人士使用。我哋不會故意收集未成年人之個人資料。如得悉有未成年人開設帳戶，我哋將立即關閉該帳戶並刪除相關資料。
children.body.en: This platform is intended for use by individuals aged 18 or above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If we become aware that a minor has created an account, we will immediately close the account and delete the related data.

section3.list.4.zh: 於買家確認落單後，按系統提示時限完成貨品交收（寄出或面交）。

section9.body.en: In the event of a dispute between buyer, seller, and/or authenticator, please first attempt to resolve it through in-platform messaging. The platform will assist in preserving conversation records, payment receipts, and authentication reports to help clarify the facts, but will not make a final ruling. branches.pointer.title.zh: 分店地址已搬去獨立頁面
branches.pointer.title.en: Branch addresses have been moved to a separate page

branches.pointer.text.zh: 而家可以管理多間分店。
branches.pointer.text.en: You can now manage multiple branches.

feeCategoryHints.title.zh: 品類建議範圍（AI 監控基準）

feeCategoryHints.monitoring.zh: 平台會以 AI 監控費率是否偏離同品類基準；異常會提示，但你可自訂。
feeCategoryHints.monitoring.en: The platform uses AI to monitor whether your fee rate deviates from category benchmarks; anomalies will be flagged, but you may set your own rates.

eoWarning.text.zh: ⚠ 保險到期前 30 日系統會提醒續保。保險失效期間你將無法接單，因為所有鑑定判定必須有 E&O 承保。
eoWarning.text.en: ⚠ The system will remind you to renew 30 days before expiry. You will not be able to take orders while insurance is lapsed, as all authentication verdicts require E&O coverage.

preview.disclaimer.zh: ★ 星級與爭議率由平台按實際完成單數演算派生，不可手動修改。此為演算法信任指標，非平台背書。
preview.disclaimer.en: ★ Star rating and dispute rate are algorithmically derived from actual completed orders and cannot be manually modified. These are algorithmic trust indicators, not platform endorsements.

validation.feeRateRange.zh: 收費百分比須介乎 0% 至 30%
validation.feeRateRange.en: Fee percentage must be between 0% and 30%

error.notAuthenticator.en: This account is not an authenticator

page.subtitle.zh: 款項於鑑定通過並完成交收後入賬
page.subtitle.en: Funds are credited after authentication passes and handover is completed

balance.pending.zh: 另有 {amount} 待入賬（{count} 宗鑑定進行中）

minWithdrawNotice.en: The minimum withdrawal amount is HKD {min}.

txn.paidSubtitle.zh: 訂單 #{id} · 已通過 · 已入賬 · {date}

txn.pendingSubtitle.zh: 訂單 #{id} · 鑑定中 · 待入賬

disclaimer.zh: 「不通過」及「未能確定」不影響鑑定費收取。金額以 server 記錄為準。
disclaimer.en: "Failed" and "Inconclusive" do not affect auth fee collection. Amounts are based on server records.

page.subtitle.zh: 買家落單揀「鑑定師面交」/「三方面交」時，會由呢度顯示嘅 active 分店揀一個交收。
page.subtitle.en: When a buyer selects "Auth Meetup" or "3-Way Meetup" at checkout, they can choose from your active branches listed here.

warning.noActive.zh: ⚠ 而家冇任何使用中嘅分店，買家無法揀你做面交鑑定。請新增最少 1 間。
warning.noActive.en: ⚠ No active branches — buyers cannot select you for meetup authentication. Please add at least 1 branch.

field.address.placeholder.zh: 例：旺角西洋菜南街 1A 號好望角大廈 5 樓 502 室
field.address.placeholder.en: e.g. Room 502, 5/F, Good Hope Building, 1A Sai Yeung Choi St S, Mong Kok

field.notes.placeholder.en: e.g. Upstairs unit, please ring bell

contacts.hint.zh: 兩個都係 optional。WhatsApp 用純數字（含國家碼），會自動生成 wa.me 連結。
contacts.hint.en: Both are optional. WhatsApp accepts digits only (including country code) — a wa.me link will be auto-generated.

field.isPrimary.label.zh: 設為主要分店（買家 checkout 預設揀呢間）
field.isPrimary.label.en: Set as primary branch (default selection at buyer checkout)

empty.zh: 仲未有分店。撳右上「新增分店」開始。
empty.en: No branches yet. Click "Add Branch" in the top right to get started.

deleteRestriction.zh: 刪除限制：如分店有進行中訂單，必須完成或取消後先可以刪除。可以暫停接單作過渡。
deleteRestriction.en: Deletion restriction: branches with active orders must complete or cancel them first before deletion. Pausing orders is available as a transitional step.

confirmDelete.consequence.zh: 呢個動作會將分店由你嘅公開檔案移除，買家將無法揀佢做面交點。有進行中訂單嘅分店 server 會擋。
confirmDelete.consequence.en: This will remove the branch from your public profile, and buyers will no longer be able to select it as a meetup location. Branches with active orders will be blocked by the server.

validation.nameAndAddressRequired.en: Branch name and address are required

page.subtitle.zh: Scan 買家（取貨）或賣家（到店交貨）App 上嘅 QR 碼
page.subtitle.en: Scan the QR code from the buyer's (pickup) or seller's (drop-off) app

done.dropoff.zh: 已接收件貨 — 可以開始鑑定
done.dropoff.en: Item received — you can now start authentication

done.pickup.zh: 交收完成 — 訂單已放款

confirmCard.verifyNotice.zh: ⚠ 請目測核對：手上件貨同上面商品相一致
confirmCard.verifyNotice.en: ⚠ Visually verify that the item in hand matches the listing above

confirmCard.verifyNotice.pickup.zh: ⚠ 請目測核對：手上件貨同上面商品相一致，同埋交收對象係本人。
confirmCard.verifyNotice.pickup.en: ⚠ Visually verify that the item in hand matches the listing above, and that the counterparty is the person you're expecting.

confirmCard.confirmBtn.pickup.zh: 確認交收（完成訂單 + 放款）

cameraPrompt.title.zh: 掃描 QR 需要用相機

cameraPrompt.body.zh: 相機畫面只用嚟即場解碼 QR，唔會錄影或者上傳。
cameraPrompt.body.en: The camera feed is used solely to decode the QR code in real time — no recording or uploading.

cameraError.unsupported.zh: 呢個 browser 環境唔支援相機（需要 HTTPS 或 localhost）
cameraError.unsupported.en: This browser environment does not support camera access (requires HTTPS or localhost)

cameraError.permissionDenied.zh: 相機權限被封鎖咗，browser 唔會再彈詢問視窗。請撳網址列嘅 🔒（或相機 icon）→ 允許相機，然後再撳「啟動相機」。用緊 Mac 嘅話，都要檢查 系統設定 → 私隱與保安 → 相機 有冇畀呢個 browser。
cameraError.permissionDenied.en: Camera access is blocked and the browser will no longer prompt. Click the 🔒 (or camera icon) in the address bar → enable camera permission, then click "Start Camera". On Mac, also check System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera to allow this browser.

cameraError.notFound.zh: 搵唔到相機裝置 — 請確認部機有相機，或者外置鏡頭插好咗。
cameraError.notFound.en: Camera device not found — please confirm your device has a camera or that an external camera is properly connected.

cameraError.inUse.zh: 相機被另一個 app 佔用緊 — 閂咗其他用緊相機嘅 app 再試。
cameraError.inUse.en: Camera is in use by another app — close any apps using the camera and try again.

cameraError.generic.zh: 開唔到鏡頭 — 請在 browser 設定畀相機權限，然後再撳「啟動相機」
cameraError.generic.en: Unable to open camera — please grant camera permission in your browser settings, then click "Start Camera"

footer.hint.zh: 對準對方 App 上嘅 QR 碼 · 碼每 60 秒更新，過期請對方刷新
footer.hint.en: Point at the QR code on the counterparty's app · The code refreshes every 60 seconds — ask them to refresh if it expires

search.placeholder.zh: 搜尋客人、商品或訂單 ID
search.placeholder.en: Search customers, items, or order ID

empty.body.zh: 收到鑑定訂單時，買賣雙方對話會出現在度。
empty.body.en: When you receive authentication orders, conversations with buyers and sellers will appear here.

noResults.hint.zh: 試客人名、商品名、品牌或訂單 ID 首 8 字。
noResults.hint.en: Try customer name, item name, brand, or first 8 characters of order ID.

emptyPane.body.zh: 買賣雙方嘅訊息會出現在度。
emptyPane.body.en: Messages from buyers and sellers will appear here.

contextPane.noListing.en: This conversation is not linked to a listing

contextPane.disclaimer.zh: 平台為資訊中介，鑑定判斷歸屬鑑定師。所有結果應如實填報並附證據。
contextPane.disclaimer.en: The platform acts as an information intermediary — authentication judgments belong to the authenticator. All results must be reported truthfully with supporting evidence.

readonly.completed.zh: 訂單已完成，對話存檔僅供查閱。
readonly.completed.en: Order completed — conversation archived for reference only.

readonly.refunded.zh: 訂單已退款，對話存檔僅供查閱。
readonly.refunded.en: Order refunded — conversation archived for reference only.

readonly.disputed.zh: 訂單爭議處理中，對話已鎖定。

sso.description.zh: 鑑定師同消費者共用登入系統。撳下面按鈕跳轉到 Certifine 登入頁（支援電郵、手機號碼、Google）。
sso.description.en: Authenticators and consumers share the same login system. Click the button below to go to the Certifine login page (supports email, phone, and Google).

local.devNotice.zh: Dev fallback — 正常情況下應該用上方 SSO
local.devNotice.en: Dev fallback — in normal operation, please use the SSO option above

demoCredentials.en:
Demo: milan@authentik.hk · procheck@authentik.hk · cardlab@authentik.hk
Password: password123

error.noAuthenticator.zh: 此帳號未有鑑定師身份。如需申請，請前往入網申請頁。
error.noAuthenticator.en: This account does not have authenticator status. To apply, please visit the onboarding page.

error.verifyFailed.en: Verification failed. Please log in again.

context.noDescription.en: Seller did not provide a description

context.buyerInfo.zh: 買家為交易對手方。鑑定真偽主要對賣家描述作判斷，買家資料一般唔影響鑑定結論。
context.buyerInfo.en: The buyer is the counterparty. Authenticity is judged against the seller's description — buyer information generally does not affect the conclusion.

sla.remaining.zh: 距截止 {h} 小時 {m} 分

ship.prompt.zh: 貨品已到？請拍攝 unboxing 相，至少 3 張。賣家會 view 後 ack。
ship.prompt.en: Has the item arrived? Please take at least 3 unboxing photographs. The seller will review and acknowledge.

meetupAuth.prompt.zh: 賣家已嚟你嘅店面交付商品？撳「準備接收」之後再影 ≥3 張相確認收貨。
meetupAuth.prompt.en: Has the seller arrived at your store to deliver the item? Click "Prepare to Receive" then take at least 3 photos to confirm receipt.

meetupAuth.startBtn.en: Seller is here, Prepare to Receive

rephoto.banner.zh: ⚠ 賣家要求重拍（第 {n} 次，總共最多 {max} 次）

rephoto.instruction.zh: 請按上述要求重新拍攝（仍係最少 3 張）。
rephoto.instruction.en: Please re-take photos as requested above (still at least 3 photos).

rephoto.exhausted.zh: ⚠ 賣家已用盡重拍機會 — 今次後賣家只能選擇確認或取消交易。
rephoto.exhausted.en: ⚠ Seller has used all re-photography attempts — after this, the seller can only confirm or cancel the transaction.

handover.photoPrompt.zh: 請拍攝商品狀況相片（最少 3 張），完成後撳「已接收」，等賣家 view 相確認。
handover.photoPrompt.en: Please take photos of the item condition (at least 3), then click "Received" to let the seller review and confirm.

handover.photoLabel.zh: 接收商品相片（賣家會 view + ack）
handover.photoLabel.en: Item Receipt Photos (seller will review + ack)

sellerAck.waiting.zh: ✓ 第 {n} 次相片已上載。等待賣家 view 後確認交付。
sellerAck.waiting.en: ✓ Attempt {n} photos uploaded. Awaiting seller review and delivery confirmation.

sellerAck.timeoutNote.zh: 如賣家逾 7 日唔 ack，訂單會自動取消，買家會獲全額退款。
sellerAck.timeoutNote.en: If the seller does not acknowledge within 7 days, the order will be automatically cancelled and the buyer will receive a full refund.

sellerAck.exhaustedNote.zh: 賣家已用盡重拍機會，只剩「確認交付」或「取消交易」兩個出路。
sellerAck.exhaustedNote.en: Seller has used all re-photography attempts — only "Confirm Delivery" or "Cancel Transaction" remain.

shipSellerAck.waiting.zh: ✓ 收件 + 影相完成。等賣家 view 相確認 condition match。
shipSellerAck.waiting.en: ✓ Receipt and photographs complete. Awaiting seller review to confirm condition match.

shipSellerAck.autoProceed.zh: 賣家 ack 後自動進入鑑定階段。
shipSellerAck.autoProceed.en: Automatically proceeds to authentication after the seller acknowledges.

awaitingPickup.title.zh: ✓ 鑑定通過。買家會嚟取貨，請在現場引導買家撳「已收到」。
awaitingPickup.title.en: ✓ Auth passed. The buyer will come to pick up — guide them to tap "Received" on site.

awaitingPickup.timeoutNote.zh: 無 timeout — 鑑定師持貨等買家來。
awaitingPickup.timeoutNote.en: No timeout — authenticator holds the item awaiting buyer pickup.

deliveryAck.prompt.zh: 買家已收貨並上載 unboxing 相。請 view 後 ack 完成交易。
deliveryAck.prompt.en: Buyer has received the item and uploaded unboxing photographs. Please review and acknowledge to complete the transaction.

deliveryAck.btn.zh: 確認買家收貨 · 釋放款項

returnPhoto.prompt.zh: 鑑定不通過。買家已退款。請上載 ≥3 張退貨相，等賣家來取時佢會 view + ack。
returnPhoto.prompt.en: Authentication failed. The buyer has been refunded. Please upload at least 3 return photographs — the seller will review and acknowledge when collecting.

returnPhoto.uploaded.zh: ✓ 退貨相已上載。等賣家嚟取回。
returnPhoto.uploaded.en: ✓ Return photographs uploaded. Awaiting seller pickup.

meetupStart.prompt.zh: 面交鑑定：買家同賣家已到場？確認開始鑑定。
meetupStart.prompt.en: Meetup Authentication: Buyer and seller both present? Confirm to start authentication.

meetupStart.prompt.direct.zh: 面交鑑定：買家已到場？確認開始鑑定。
meetupStart.prompt.direct.en: Meetup Authentication: Buyer present? Confirm to start authentication.

disputed.body.zh: Certifine 為資訊中介，唔裁決爭議。請拎相片 + IM 對話作為證據，自行同對方解決（包括法律途徑）。
disputed.body.en: Certifine is an information intermediary and does not adjudicate disputes. Use photos and chat conversations as evidence to resolve directly with the counterparty (including legal channels).

waitingForShip.en: Awaiting shipment of the item by the seller...

workspace.evidence.title.zh: 1. 鑑定證據（影片 / 圖片）

workspace.evidence.desc.zh: 請上載鑑定過程嘅錄影同 / 或關鍵特寫圖片。最少 1 個檔案。每個檔案最大 50MB。
workspace.evidence.desc.en: Please upload video recordings and/or close-up images of the authentication process. Minimum 1 file. Max 50MB per file.

workspace.evidence.uploadBtn.meetup.zh: 面交錄影檔 + 關鍵圖片（撳開啟相機 / 揀檔案）
workspace.evidence.uploadBtn.meetup.en: Meetup recording + key images (tap to open camera / select files)

workspace.evidence.uploadBtn.ship.zh: 撳呢度揀鑑定影片 / 圖片（支援 .mp4 .mov .jpg .png）
workspace.evidence.uploadBtn.ship.en: Click here to select authentication video/images (supports .mp4 .mov .jpg .png)

workspace.evidence.filesHeader.zh: 已揀檔案（{count}）· 已上載 {committed} 個

workspace.evidence.storageNotice.zh: ⓘ 證據檔案目前只儲存在你嘅瀏覽器，提交鑑定前唔好離開呢頁。上傳到平台儲存（永久存檔／爭議仲裁）係 backlog feature。
workspace.evidence.storageNotice.en: ⓘ Evidence files are currently stored only in your browser — do not leave this page before submitting. Server-side storage (permanent archive / dispute arbitration) is a backlog feature.

workspace.evidence.3wayNotice.zh: 三方面交：請確保買家、賣家同時在場。鑑定結論需向雙方當面宣讀後才提交。
workspace.evidence.3wayNotice.en: 3-Way meetup: Please ensure both buyer and seller are present. Read the verdict to both parties in person before submitting.

workspace.checklist.desc.zh: 逐項對比實物與賣家描述。FAILED / INCONCLUSIVE 時可以在右邊 flag 「與描述不符」嘅項目。
workspace.checklist.desc.en: Compare each item against the seller's description. For FAILED / INCONCLUSIVE, flag items that "don't match description" on the right.

workspace.checklist.mismatchTooltip.zh: 標記此項與賣家描述不符
workspace.checklist.mismatchTooltip.en: Mark this item as not matching the seller's description

workspace.verdict.mismatchHint.zh: 建議：在上面 Checklist 每項旁邊按「不符」標記同賣家描述唔吻合嘅地方。
workspace.verdict.mismatchHint.en: Suggestion: Tap "Mismatch" next to each checklist item above to flag discrepancies with the seller's description.

workspace.verdict.mismatchAutoNote.zh: 系統會自動將你標記咗嘅項目寫入下面 Notes，方便日後爭議仲裁時引用。
workspace.verdict.mismatchAutoNote.en: Flagged items will be automatically written into the Notes below for reference in any future dispute arbitration.

workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.in.zh: 選擇「無法判定」代表你無法對這件貨品作出明確鑑定結論。後續處理：
workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.in.en: Selecting "Inconclusive" means you cannot reach a definitive authentication conclusion. Next steps:

workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.it.zh: 平台將通知買賣雙方，訂單會進入退款流程
workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.it.en: The platform will notify both parties and the order will enter the refund process

workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.it.zh: 買家將獲全額退款（如使用線上託管）
workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.it.en: Buyer will receive a full refund (if using online escrow)
Item to be collected by the seller

workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.it.zh: 你的鑑定費將按合約釐定是否適用 — 視乎具體情況可能部分收取或豁免
workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.it.en: Your auth fee will be determined per contract — may be partially charged or waived depending on circumstances

workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.fo.zh: 如有疑問，建議先聯絡平台再提交。
workspace.verdict.inconclusiveDetails.fo.en: If in doubt, contact the platform before submitting.

workspace.notes.placeholder.zh: 任何需向買家披露的細節…
workspace.notes.placeholder.en: Any details to disclose to the buyer...

workspace.notes.hint.zh: FAILED / INCONCLUSIVE 時，標記咗「不符」嘅 checklist 項目會自動寫入呢度。可自由 edit 補充說明。
workspace.notes.hint.en: For FAILED / INCONCLUSIVE verdicts, flagged checklist items will be auto-populated here. You can freely edit and add notes.

workspace.handoverCheckbox.zh: 貨物已當面交予買家 — 三方同場，提交 PASSED 後訂單即完成並放款（買家唔使再確認）
workspace.handoverCheckbox.en: Item has been handed over to buyer in person — all three parties present. Submitting PASSED will complete the order and release funds (no buyer confirmation needed)

workspace.signature.label.zh: 電子簽名（輸入你的全名以確認）
workspace.signature.label.en: Electronic Signature (enter your full name to confirm)

workspace.signature.hint.zh: 簽名提交後，本鑑定結果將具法律效力。鑑定錯誤將按你的合約 + E&O 保險條款追償。
workspace.signature.hint.en: Once submitted with your signature, this authentication result becomes legally binding. Errors will be subject to recourse under your contract and E&O insurance terms.

confirmVerdict.desc.passed.zh: 提交後將通知買家到場取貨，escrow 將於買家確認收貨後釋放畀賣家。
confirmVerdict.desc.passed.en: After submission, the buyer will be notified to pick up. Escrow funds will be released to the seller upon buyer's pickup confirmation.

confirmVerdict.desc.failed.zh: 提交後買家將獲全額退款，貨品退回賣家。
confirmVerdict.desc.failed.en: After submission, the buyer will receive a full refund and the item will be returned to the seller.

confirmVerdict.desc.inconclusive.zh: 提交後訂單轉入爭議流程，平台會介入處理。
confirmVerdict.desc.inconclusive.en: After submission, the order enters the dispute process and the platform will step in.

confirmVerdict.irreversible.zh: ⚠️ 鑑定結果提交後不可撤回。鑑定錯誤將按合約 + E&O 保險條款追償。
confirmVerdict.irreversible.en: ⚠️ Authentication results cannot be withdrawn after submission. Errors will be subject to recourse under your contract and E&O insurance terms.

confirmVerdict.confirmLabel.passed.en: I confirm and submit the Authentic result

confirmVerdict.confirmLabel.failed.en: I confirm and submit the Counterfeit result

confirmVerdict.confirmLabel.inconclusive.en: I confirm and submit the Inconclusive result

confirmDispute.desc.zh: 提出後訂單會凍結，平台會介入處理。請清楚簡述原因（將寫入 audit log，買賣雙方可見）。
confirmDispute.desc.en: The order will be frozen and the platform will step in. Please clearly state the reason (will be logged to the audit trail, visible to both parties).

confirmDispute.reasonPlaceholder.zh: 例：商品同 listing 描述不符；證據相發現偽造痕跡…
confirmDispute.reasonPlaceholder.en: e.g. Item doesn't match listing description; evidence photos show signs of tampering...

checklist.HANDBAG.0.zh: 外觀：縫線整齊度、皮料紋理

checklist.HANDBAG.1.zh: 五金：刻字深度、電鍍光澤

checklist.HANDBAG.3.zh: 隨附：購買單據、防塵袋、原裝盒
checklist.HANDBAG.3.en: Accessories: Receipt, dust bag, original box

checklist.POKEMON_CARD.3.zh: PSA / BGS 紙盒真偽（如有）

validation.receiptPhotos.zh: 請上載至少 3 張收件 unboxing 相
validation.receiptPhotos.en: Please upload at least 3 unboxing photographs

validation.handoverPhotos.zh: 請上載至少 3 張接收時嘅相
validation.handoverPhotos.en: Please upload at least 3 handover photographs

validation.returnPhotos.zh: 請上載至少 3 張退貨相
validation.returnPhotos.en: Please upload at least 3 return photographs

validation.evidenceUploading.zh: 證據檔案仲在上載中，請等候完成
validation.evidenceUploading.en: Evidence files are still uploading. Please wait.

validation.evidenceRequired.zh: 請至少上載一個鑑定影片 / 圖片證據
validation.evidenceRequired.en: Please upload at least one authentication video or image as evidence
